source_summary: Horizontal Chinese ink landscape with pale blue-gray mountain washes, textured cliffs, pine-topped ridges, a small riverside pavilion with a seated scholar, and a rocky watercourse; calligraphy, seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded from motif extraction.

motifs.name: left_overhanging_cliff
motifs.description: Isolate the tall upper-left cliff mass with its overhanging rock face, descending vertical wall, pale wash interior, dry-brush contour lines, and scattered dark texture dots along the cliff edge.
must_preserve: black moss-dot texture following the cliff edge

motifs.name: central_misty_peak_screen
motifs.description: Isolate the hazy central background mountains: a screen of pale vertical limestone-like peaks rising through mist, with soft horizontal gray washes behind them.
must_preserve: subtle tonal transitions between peaks and fog

motifs.name: left_foreground_pine_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-left foreground cliff group with stacked rock faces, dark moss dots, and dense bands of short-needled pines along the ledges.
must_preserve: short needle strokes on pine crowns
dark base accents at the foot of the cliff

motifs.name: central_saddle_ridge_pines
motifs.description: Isolate the low central saddle ridge above the pavilion area, including its rolling rock outline, scattered dark dots, and continuous pine-brush bands cresting the slope.
must_preserve: light gray wash beneath the ridge

motifs.name: thatched_pavilion_scholar
motifs.description: Isolate the small riverside pavilion or hut at the lower center with its long angular roof, simple wall lines, window lattice, and seated scholar figure beneath the eaves.
must_preserve: pale ground wash around the structure

motifs.name: right_pine_terrace_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the long middle-right terrace of cliffs and hills, topped with irregular pine bands and punctuated by vertical rock walls and dark texture dots.
must_preserve: jagged pine crowns along ridge tops
soft wash separating terraces from distant haze

motifs.name: rocky_water_reaches
motifs.description: Isolate the lower-right watercourse with gray-blue water wash, exposed stones and islets, dark stippled banks, and shallow shoreline marks.
must_preserve: soft transition from water to misty bank

motifs.name: foreground_reed_shrub_bank
motifs.description: Isolate the small foreground bank between the pavilion and water, with low reed and shrub clumps drawn in curved ink strokes and pale ground wash.

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
